welcome:
👨‍💻 *Help technology understand your language!*

Spend just 5–10 minutes reading sentences aloud or validating recordings from other contributors.

Your voice helps build open speech technology. Selected language: *{language}*.
privacy:
🔐 Privacy

The bot stores your Telegram ID, name, username, last activity time, selected Common Voice language, and reminder schedule so it can provide its features. It does not store voice recordings.

Inactive profiles are deleted after 365 days. You can delete your data immediately with /delete_me or /stop.

reminder.help:
⏰ Contribution reminders

Times use the Europe/Kyiv timezone and 24-hour HH:MM format.

Daily:
/remind_daily 14:30

Weekly:
/remind_weekly 1 14:30

Weekdays: 1=Monday through 7=Sunday.

Show: /reminder
Disable: /reminder_off
